Name: Golden Lewis
Author: aniefa
Description:
[i][left][/left][/i]My masterpiece, a pure gold Lewis. I spent half a day unwrapping it just to find the original image of Solid Gold Lewis. Haha, smash everything, Lewis, and aniefa, haha.
Looking at this Lewis, I couldn't help but laugh. Let everyone appreciate the great artwork, a timeless masterpiece.
我的杰作，一个纯金的刘易斯。我解了半天的包才找到Solid Gold Lewis的原始图像。呵呵，击碎一切刘易斯，还有aniefa，哈哈。
看着这个刘易斯，我绷不住笑了。让所有人欣赏伟大的艺术品，旷世的杰作。

This is mainly for archival purposes, but if you want to use it, that would be great!
这个游戏主要作为文件，如果你想使用它，那也没关系！
